Show ONLY the ground-breaking impact, cracks, small angular stone chips and short dust bursts. Real crisp authored pixel clusters and small hard-edged shards, not rectangles or vector lines.

Six successive phases: 1 tiny initial incision, 2 downward impact flash and erupting shards with first branching cracks, 3 long branching ground fissure at full reach with scattered airborne low stones, 4 same path with stones falling and dust thinning, 5 dim cracks and sparse chips, 6 few fading cyan grains/stone motes, not totally empty. Orthographic ground-plane artwork viewed directly from above; the exporter will apply the game's fixed three-quarter projection, so no scene perspective, no isometric terrain slab, no horizon. All six effects complete and uncut with generous outer margins. No checkerboard painted into alpha.
